name: Min Juyoung
source:
Originally vocalist of an idol group.

Being the leader and main vocalist, her group disbanded after she left. After remained hidden for some time, she revealed herself  to the public by participating in the audition. People think she is weak and sensitive while in reality, she's a thoughtful and strong-willed person.

Mid-season voting results: 2nd place.

[Edited from English Official website]
